prose: Our new friend Katie Hess of LOTUSWEI joins Vibe Rant to mix it up with our herbalist regulars, Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs) and Michelle Lundquist (Michelle's Healing Home). We'll let this meeting of the minds play out with its own organic flow, but expect to learn about making flower essences and their gentle yet transformative effects. Flower Power, y'all!
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
